description: Irrigation Dams (WCORP-294) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Corporation. The Water Corporation layer is a spatial representation of a facility for holding water and the supplying of water to land by man-made means to aid in growing crops. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Corporation. Its tags are Dams, Infrastructure, Irrigation, Utilities, Water Corporation. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
